title: Imaginary quadratic fields with class group of exponent 7: certificate, search and logs
description: Code, interval-arithmetic certificate, search logs and LaTeX note for the result: assuming GRH for the quadratic Dirichlet L-functions of prime conductor, no fundamental discriminant D with 3.1e20 <= |D| <= 1e32 has class group of exponent 7. With Elsenhans-Klüners-Nicolae (Acta Arith. 193, 2020) and Aiken-Ross-Shvydkoy-Xue (arXiv:2605.26020, Theorem 1.3(6)) this shows that under ERH there are exactly 33 imaginary quadratic fields and 40 imaginary quadratic orders with class group of exponent 7.
